Projets.title: My Projects
Projets.subtitle: Discover my recent work
Projets.descriptionFolio:
Personal portfolio website developed with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, Next-themes and Next-intl (i18n). Showcase of my projects, skills and experiences. Responsive design with subtle animations for a smooth user experience.
This platform is available on both Desktop and mobile versions.
To reach a diverse audience, I integrated a complete multilingual interface allowing visitors to switch languages instantly.
Projets.longDescriptionFolio: Personal web application developed to present my projects, skills and experiences in a professional and attractive way.
Projets.presentationFolio: This platform is multilingual with the ability to change themes (dark and light) and allows you to scan based on the language to automatically generate my CV.
Projets.architectureFolio:
Development of a personal portfolio website using Next.js for the React framework, TypeScript for type safety, Shadcn for design and Tailwind CSS.
A very simple architecture with a Next.js static export project without backend.
Clear structure separating data (projects, skills, experiences) from presentation components, facilitating maintenance and evolution of the site.
Responsive design to ensure an optimal user experience on all devices, with subtle animations to improve interactivity.
Projets.defisFolio: Design of an attractive and easy-to-navigate user interface to effectively present my projects and skills. Implementation of a responsive design to ensure a smooth user experience across different devices and screen sizes. Integration of subtle animations to enhance interactivity without compromising site performance.
Projets.resultatsFolio: Development of a functional and aesthetically pleasing portfolio website to present my projects and skills in a professional manner. Improvement of my frontend development skills with Next.js, TypeScript, Shadcn and Tailwind CSS. Enhancement of my Next.js project organization skills, by structuring data efficiently and creating reusable components for easier maintenance. Ability to deploy a static web application on GitHub Pages, by correctly configuring the Next.js project for static export and managing aspects related to deployment on GitHub Pages. Enriching experience in designing a complete web application, covering both frontend development and implementation of responsive design with animations for a better user experience.
Projets.etatActuelFolio: Project completed and deployed online. The site is accessible at https://syllaaboubacar.github.io/ and the source code is available on GitHub. I continue to keep the site updated with my new projects and experiences.
Projets.descriptionTicket:
Ticket management application for customer support. Backend Java Spring Boot with REST API, frontend React (Next.js) + TypeScript. Features: ticket creation/assignment, status tracking, email notifications.
For proactive oversight, a monitoring module is connected to client infrastructures, while an email notification system ensures real-time communication on the progress of each ticket.
Projets.longDescriptionTicket: This platform allows daily reception of customer requests related to various issues and proposals regarding the applications they use, then having them processed by lead staff. This constitutes a communication channel between clients and service providers.
Projets.presentationTicket:
Ticket management application developed in pairs, aiming to create an efficient system for customer support.
Backend developed with Java Spring Boot exposing a REST API, and frontend developed in React (Next.js) with TypeScript.
Key features: ticket creation and assignment, ticket status tracking, email notification system to inform users of updates on their tickets.
Projets.architectureTicket:
Development of a REST API with Java Spring Boot to manage operations related to customer support tickets.
Design of a modular architecture with separation of responsibilities between the different layers of the application (controllers, services, repositories).
Use of JPA/Hibernate for data persistence in a relational database, ensuring efficient management of tickets and users.
Implementation of security with Spring Security to protect API endpoints and manage user roles and permissions.
Development of an intuitive user interface with React (Next.js) and TypeScript to allow users to create, track and manage their customer support tickets easily.
Use of RTK Query to manage REST API calls and synchronize data between frontend and backend efficiently.
Design with Shadcn to ensure an optimal user experience on all devices, with particular attention to accessibility and ease of use.
Projets.defisTicket:
Design of an efficient REST API to manage ticket-related operations, while ensuring application security and performance.
Development of an intuitive user interface to allow users to create, track and manage their tickets easily.
Development of an intuitive user interface to allow users to create, track and manage their tickets easily.
Implementation of a reliable email notification system to ensure users are informed of updates on their tickets in real time.
Projets.resultatsTicket:
The expected outcome of this project is:
- Development of a functional ticket management application, allowing users to create and track their customer support tickets efficiently.
- Improvement of my full-stack development skills, particularly in REST API design with Spring Boot and frontend development with React and Next.js.
- Enriching experience in designing a complete application, covering both backend and frontend development, as well as integration of complex features such as email notifications.
Projets.etatActuelTicket: Active development in pairs, currently in frontend phase. No imposed deadline, we are progressing according to our availability.
Projets.titleTpe: Development of visualization tools for genomic data analysis
Projets.descriptionTpe:
Developing a data extraction, cleaning, and transformation platform for visual analysis purposes, similar to tools like Sniplay.
Technologies used: Python, Flask, Jquery, Javascript, 3D.js, HighCharts.
Projets.longDescriptionTpe: Design of a web-based visualization tool for the detection, management, and analysis of SNPs using tools such as D3.js, Canvas, Javascript, and WebService API.
Projets.presentationTpe:
This tool allows to:
- Extract genomic data.
- Convert data into a format suitable for visualization.
- Generate different types of visualization graphs.
- Integrate data migration in various forms.
Projets.architectureTpe:
The proposed solution consists of designing a web-based application (HTML+JavaScript) entirely executed in the browser, capable of:
Taking as input a VCF genomic data file located locally or remotely.
Implementing the ETL process (Extract, Transform, Load) using Python, Flask, Jquery, Javascript, 3D.js, HighCharts.
Projets.defisTpe:
The main challenge was to develop visualization graphs such as:
Density by individuals (heatmap).
MAF (histogram).
PCA (scatterplot).
Q estimates (histogram).
Make the tool better adapted to other data formats.
Plan other types of 3D visualizations.
Projets.resultatsTpe: Although this activity was carried out as part of a supervised personal project during the first year of the Master's program, the results were tested, approved, and conclusive.
Projets.etatActuelTpe: The tool was made available to the supervisor who proposed the topic, for its use and potential improvements.
Projets.titleSearch: Dynamic analysis and visualization of interactions between databases and programs in hybrid systems
Projets.descriptionSearch:
Development of an analysis and comprehension tool for database manipulation logic behaviors within an information system.
Study of the historical evolution of software systems at given times t-1 and t by capturing SQL and NoSQL traces.
Projets.longDescriptionSearch:
This approach exposes the evolution history of the database schema, by studying the lifetime of all objects.
It also enables the extraction of database accesses from the source code.
Projets.presentationSearch:
This platform aims to:
- Analyze and understand how the database and source code have co-evolved over time.
- Support the adaptation of source code when the database changes.
Projets.architectureSearch:
An approach for migration, co-evolution, and coexistence of relational databases and NoSQL databases within the same system.
A technique for conceptual re-documentation of database usage in the source code.
Temporal structuring of data using extracted features and dynamic classification of data evolution within query execution processes.
Projets.defisSearch:
The challenges aimed at improving the understanding of software systems using the following techniques:
Dynamic analysis and visualization of programs.
Exploration of interaction processes.
Projets.resultatsSearch: The tool for capturing user interaction traces was implemented and tested on a local system with two data paradigms (SQL and NoSQL).
Projets.etatActuelSearch: This research project was suspended due to a lack of testing the tool on real systems with multiple data paradigms and massive data volumes.
